scope: Public real-document excerpts with controlled synthetic answer-hijacking attacks; complete-page support tested separately. Not representative production traffic or naturally occurring malicious files.

ollama.context_note: Application does not explicitly set num_ctx. All generated excerpts fit the bounded short-input cohort; no complete-page generation is claimed.

method: One actual ungated response per short case, reused for every gate when forwarded. Complete-page probes instrument generator handoff without Llama generation.
